tei:div.tei:p: (ma)༄༅// rje rong chen la bstod pa tshan gnyis bzhugs// rje rong chen thams cad mkhyen pa la rgyun chags kyi sdeb sbyor sgo nas bstod pa/ ma lus yang yang 'thungs pa'i thugs rje'i spu phreng dkar po cher g.yo gzungs ngang mngon par shes pa'i rtsal gyis legs bshad rin chen bye ma skyugs pa'i bsdu rnam bzhi yi glang chen rta dang khyu mchog ri dwags dbang po'i kha nas legs 'ongs so sor yang dag rig rnam bzhi yi pad phreng 'dzum pa'i drwa bas steng nas khebs pa'i phrin las bdud rtsi'i rlabs chen 'thor ba dang ldan skal bzang nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rigs dang mthun par so so'i khams la gsal bar rab rgyu 'khor ba'i sa chen 'di yi pha mtha' tshol 'drar rgyun mi chad par 'bab pa 'di ni khyod kyi mdzad pa yin te de bsam khyed ni shākya seng ge'i rgyal tshab mtshan ma med pa'i chos tshul stong gi lam srol 'byed mkhas shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing gi mtha' klas khyod kyi mtshan nas brjod pa'i grags pa'i rnga chen brdungs pas 'jigs pa'i ngan 'gro'i 'jig rten pa rnams mtho ris khang pa'i yang thog rtse mor bros nas skyabs gzhan tshol ba'i nga ro sgrog tshe brtse ba'i lcags kyu rnon pos rab bzung dad dang brtson pa'i shing rta yangs par khrims dang thos pa'i go cha byin pas sa chen bcu yi them skas rnams ni rim par bsgral nas chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang chen por sgyu ma'i gar gyis rol du 'jug pa 'di ni shākya'i skyes mchog stobs bcu ldan pa'i de'i yang bla mar gyur snyam bdag ni bstod tshig gser gyi rgyal mtshan sgreng ba lags kyis sa gsum 'gro la kun dga'i dpal ster shākya'i bstan pa 'chi med nor bu'i gdugs dkar legs bshad pad+ma ra ga'i rgyal mtshan rtse la 'god mkhas khyod kyi dge legs ma lus myur du stsol// de ltar khyod la rgyun chags kyi// sdeb sbyor sgo nas bstod pas bdag

/khyod kyi mdzad pa'i pha mtha' la// blo gros yangs pa thob gyur cig /khyod kyis rab 'byams mdo lung legs sbyangs gnad bkag ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen gleng gzhi rnam 'byed rjes bcas chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun tshul khrims ldan pa 'dul 'dzin yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje btsun pa'i mchog gyur mkhan chen rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab byams sa sde legs sbyangs bden bzhi ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen mtshan nyid rnam 'byed phung khams chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun shes rab ldan pa mngon 'dzin yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje mkhas pa'i mchog gyur paṇa chen rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab 'byams shes phyin legs sbyangs zab mo ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen thabs tshul rnam 'byed phyin drug chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun byang sems ldan pa mdo 'dzin yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje bzang po'i mchog gyur sems dpa' rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab 'byams rgyud sde legs sbyangs mtha' drug ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen tshul bzhi rnam 'byed rim gnyis chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun dam tshig ldan pa sngags 'dzin yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje grub pa'i mchog gyur khyab bdag rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab 'byams sde bdun legs sbyangs rtog ge ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen rigs pa rnam 'byed tshad ma'i chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun rnam dpyod ldan pa rigs smra yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje rigs smra'i mchog gyur rtsod mdzad rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab 'byams sgra tshogs legs sbyangs bying rkyen ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen nyer rgyur rnam 'byed rnam dbye'i chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun nges tshig ldan pa sgra pa yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje brda sprod mchog gyur 'chad mdzad rong ston rgyal// khyod kyis rab 'byams tshig rgyan legs sbyangs sdeb sbyor ji bzhin mkhyen// mkhyen pas rgya chen mngon brjod rnam 'byed snyan ngags chos lugs mkhas// mkhas mchog bzang btsun snyan grags ldan pa smra mkhas yongs kyi dpal// dpal ldan chos rje legs bshad mchog gyur rtsom mdzad rong stong rgyal/

*/'di bar kun bzang 'khor lo yin pa 'dra/ ༄༅// rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rje kun dga'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub kyi 'bras bzang stsol bar byed pa zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rlabs chen shugs drag thugs rje'i spyan yangs pas// 'gro kun sgrol mdzad rje btsun chos kyi rje// bdag snying mchog dga'i lte bar rab bzhugs la// bzang po'i mgon gyis bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun dga'i zla zer phyogs brgyar g.yos pa las// skal ba bzang pos bag yod gyur rnams la// thar pa'i grong khyer ji bzhin ston mkhas pa'i// khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma de la 'dud// phun tshogs tshogs gnyis stong gis bskrun pa'i sku// gsung rab rab 'byams ma lus ston pa'i gsung*// gang thugs thugs rje'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can// kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i gter mnga' de la 'dud// dang po'i srid pa'i 'byor pa brgya phrag zhig /dbang po'i gzhu ltar gzigs pa'i lhag bsam gyis// yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan la legs zhugs nas// sgo gsum nyes pas dben pa de la 'dud// phra zhing phra ba'i gnang bkag ma lus pa// ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis// ma dag spyod pa ring du rgyang bsrings pa'i// nyan thos chen po de la gus pas 'dud// 'gro 'di'i phan bde'i khur chen ma lus pa// snying stobs chen po'i brtse bas legs blangs te// rgyal sras spyod pas nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba'i// sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la snying nas 'dud// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dpung tshogs mi dman pas// shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod ma lus pa// legs par rtogs nas gzhan la 'doms mdzad pa'i// kun gyis phyag byar 'os pa de la 'dud// rigs can rnams la rang dang rjes mthun pa'i// theg pas rgyud sbyangs zab mo'i lam bstan nas// tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas stsol mkhas pa'i// rab 'byams bstan pa'i mnga' bdag de la 'dud// mtshungs bral rnam dpyod chen po'i dge legs kyis// rgya chen gzhung brgya'i de nyid 'byed pa la// gzhan gyi dring gis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po de la 'dud// rgya chen chos kyi spyan stong rab mnga' ba'i// chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi cod paṇa las// gzhan du zhabs zung nam yang mi 'dor ba'i// gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan de la 'dud// rtag tu mun pa'i phung por skyabs song ba'i// phyogs re'i mig can log par mgu rnams kyang*// khyod gsung zla ba'i zer phreng la chags pa// snyigs dus mtshan mo'i mgon po de la 'dud// dri med lung gi glog stong gis 'khyud pa'i// rnam dag rigs pa'i rdo rje'i zer phreng ni// phas rgol dregs pa'i snying la 'beb mkhas pa// rgya chen rigs pa'i dbang phyug de la 'dud// khyod gzhung stobs dgra'i rtse brgya 'phros pa las// rang bzos myos pa'i stobs ldan dpung tshogs bzhi// chos min smra ba'i ca co rab btang nas// sa 'og mun par 'jug mkhas de la 'dud// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i mthu grub pas// chos kyi zol gyis chos min smra ba'i gzhung*// rnam par 'joms mkhas rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan ni// srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng mkhas de la 'dud// dpal ldan e waṃ chos kun ldan pa'i gnas// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi 'byung khungs cher// bde stong sgyu ma'i gar la rtag rol ba'i// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// dri med dbang dang rnam dag rgyud bshad dang*// gdams pa'i lus rdzogs rnga gsang mthon pa'i sa// dkyil 'khor rnam bzhir sku bzhi sgrub ba'i thabs// ston mdzad sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams thub pa'i ring lugs mtha' dag dang*// khyad par du yang zab mo sngags kyi lam// dus 'dir khyod nyid kho nas gsal mdzad pa// mtshungs med bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// phyi nang chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la// dbang 'byor chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba ni// srid gsum 'di na khyod las gzhan yod min// de phyir stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres sogs// dge legs yon tan kun gyi gter mnga' ba'i// khyod kyi legs par bshad pa mtha' dag ni// tshad bzung nus par brjod pa min mod kyi// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa'i// tshul las brtsams te cung zad bstod pa yi// dge ba de yang 'gro ba ma lus pa// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i rgyu ru bsngo// sngon bsags bsod nams brgya yis legs bskrun pa'i// dal 'byor gru bzang smon pa'i ba dan can// mtshungs med dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung ba 'di// rnam dag tshul khrims rgya mtshor bsgrod par shog

/spu gri'i sor chags sbrang rtsi myang ba ltar// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dag gis cher bsnun pa'i// srid pa'i bde la yid brtan mi rung bas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs// theg pa mchog ston bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// rdo rje'i lus la lhun grub dkyil 'khor bzhir// rnam dkar dbang bzhis rgyal ba'i sku bzhi po// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de skad brjod 'di le lo yi// rgya mtshor bying kyang dbang med du// bskul bar byed pa'i nan tshig ngor// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yin no// tshul 'di rnam dpyod chen po'i khri stengs su// phyi nang gzhung dang tha snyad phal cher la// mun pa phyogs tsam gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis// gzhan gyi yon tan ji bzhin mi mthong mod// sdom gsum gus pas nos pa'i bla ma la// dad pa'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba'i dpal yon las// glo bur bstod pa'i 'brug stong sgrog pa po/ shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo// ces bya ba 'di na tshod ldan gyi lo/ gro bzhin can gyi dkar phyogs kyi/ stong pa dang po'i snga dro'i cha la/ sgo gsum mi dge ba'i bya ba rgyang ring du spangs te/ rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing*/ rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la g.yel ba med pa'i/ dge slong shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya bas legs par bskul zhing*/ mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gyur pa/ shākya'i dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros kyis/ mngon brjod dang*/ tshig rgyan gyis ma bcings par dpal e waṃ chos ldan thub chen mngon par dga' ba'i dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rje de nyid la bstod pa// ༄// kye ho/ ngo mtshar sprul pa'i ya mtshan kun bsdus nas// bkod legs mdzes sdug brjid pa'i khri stengs su// 'od 'bar nyi zla'i zhabs rten nyams dga' bar// brtse chen bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi bdag

/gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje rnam gsum khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// rgyal ba rigs lnga khyod kyi phung po lnga// yum chen rnam bzhi khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// dngos kun byin rlob nges par 'khor lo'i mgon// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// khro chen rnam bcu khyod kyi tshigs chen bcu// rgyal sras rnam brgyad nang gi skye mched du// rim par sprul nas yul la longs spyod cing*// ma lus bgegs dpung 'joms mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin lhun grub bcos min pho brang du// ma lus rigs kyi bdag po'i skur 'khrungs nas// snod bcud ma lus rigs brgya'i rnam rol du// nges par gzigs nas rigs par ston mdzad pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob sgyu ma 'di kun gzugs kyi sku// don dam spros pa'i mtha' bral chos kyi sku// bden gnyis zung 'jug sku gnyis dbyer med du// ston mdzad phrin las dbang po chos kyi rje// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun phar phyin theg pas rgyud sbyangs nas// zag med dga' bzhi'i lam gyis grol mdzad pa// phrin las bzang po rje btsun bla ma nyid// nges par bzhad pa'i rdo rjer mthong gyur nas// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// brtse chen bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum dang*// mar gyur 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum po// gnyis med ye shes rang rig bde chen du// ro gcig ngang nas rtse gcig gus pa yis// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol ba btab ba'i legs byas kyis// phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun thob nas// g.yo med phyag rgya chen po'i rnam rol gyis// 'gro kun smin grol byed par byin gyis rlobs// ces bya ba ni rje btsun bla ma la gsol ba 'debs byed/

thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs nyer 'jug ces pa yin no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rje bla ma la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ chos kun kun la legs par 'doms pa'i gsung*// mchog dga' dga' bzhi'i rtse mor son pa'i thugs// blo bzang bzang po'i lam du 'khrid pa'i sku// snyan grags grags pa'i dbang phyug mang po'i mgon// zab cing rgya che'i chos kun khyod kyis bshad// zag med dga' bzhi'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag /phrin las bzang pos don mthun slob ma'i tshogs// smin zhing grol mdzad brtse chen chos kyi rje// 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyis rgan por rlom byed pa// phal cher byis pa'i blo gros ltar byed cing*// lung dang rigs pas rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu// mngon par rlom pa'i gzhung lugs mun par bya// tshig nyung don mang sdeb legs ldan pa yis// gong ma'i dgongs pa skong mdzad gzhung rtsom mkhan// de phyir khyod kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la// bsting tshig smra byed de dag byis pa'i tshul// gang khyod mkhas btsun bzang po'i khrir 'khod nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i chos la thogs med pa'i// phrin las bzang po'i nyi ma sa chen gsum// gsal bar byas la su zhig 'gran par sems// khyod kyi nang don mkhyen pa'i nyin byed ni// tha snyad gzhung brgya'i mdangs kyis spras pa na// mkhas par rlom pa'i rgyu skar phal cher bas// dregs pa'i 'od brgya mgyogs par btang min nam// khyod kyi sku gsung btsun pa 'char ka'i mdangs// thub bstan shar ri'i phrag pa la zhon tshe// btsun por rlom pa'i pa sangs rjes 'brang bcas// ma lus rdol ba bzhin du byas min nam// kun spyod rab gtsang li khri'i mdangs gsal ba// gsung dbyangs 'char ka'i 'od dang lhan cig tu// blo bzang la la'i dpal du shar ba na// mang po'i kun spyod rme bar byas min nam// rang gzhan gzhung brgya'i rol mo mkhan khyod kyis// lung dang rigs pa'i rgyal rnga brdungs pa na// bdud kyi gsang tshig rol mor byed pa yi// phyi rgol dregs pa'i smra ba bcad min nam// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi gdung 'dzin sa skya pa'i// dgongs don gsal ba'i legs bshad dngul dkar gyi// me long bstar ba gang 'dir bstan pa na// la la'i rang gzugs gsal bar shar min nam// khyod kyi byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul gyis// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las la// 'gong 'dod gzhan gyi bzang po'i brtul zhugs ni// brtse chen khyod kyis lan brgyar brgal min nam// chos tshul re re'i de nyid gsungs pa na// bsdus pa'i don gyis nges pa myur bskyed cing*// dgos pa'i don gyis dad pa 'dren byas nas// brgal lan rgyas pas lugs gzhan mtha' bsal te// tshig don gsal bar 'chad pa khyod kyi lugs// lung dang rigs pa'i gnad rnams nges mdzad nas// gzhan dang mi mthun gtso bor byed pa yi// rang bzo mkhan po'i gzhung gi rjes 'jug pa'i// 'khyog po'i blo gros srong ba khyod kho na// khas blangs gtan tshigs mi mthun phyogs dag la// 'gog pa'i tshad ma nges par bsam byas nas// thal ba'i chos la lung dang rigs pa yi// bsal ba ston pa khyod kyi rtsod pa'i tshul// rtsod pa'i khyu mchog gzhan la 'di yod dam// de phyir ljongs 'dir bla med theg pa la// 'dod lha'i zhags pas bcings pa'i gzhung lugs ni// nges par bsnyil ba'i bka' drin khyod kyis mdzad// de ltar khyod kyi mkhas btsun bzang po dang*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la dad byas nas// rnyog bral ngag gis bstod pa'i dge ba yis// khyod bzhin bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal gyur cig

/mkhas btsun bzang pos rang rgyud smin byas nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gzhan rgyud grol byas te// bdag dang don mthun slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun// chos kyi rgyal po'i khri la 'khod gyur cig /ces rje btsun bla ma la mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ dad pa'i shing rta 'dren byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nye bar thob pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos sbyar ba yin no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rje de nyid la bstod pa/ ༄// na mo gu rā we/ kun spyod rnam dag dang 'dren pa'i sku// gzhan phan la dga' dam chos sgrogs pa'i gsung*// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs mnga' ba// 'phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// zhi ba'i tshul khrims rang bzhin nyes pas dben// rnam dag tshul khrims bcas pa'i rwa ba las// nam yang mi 'da' thub pa'i ring lugs pa// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la mgos phyag 'tshal// byams pa'i shugs kyis 'gro mang dbang du bsdud// thugs rje'i stobs kyis gdul bya'i dbul ba 'joms// rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa'i// rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por mgos phyag 'tshal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rong ston rje'i// zab yang chos kyi khri la dbang bsgyur pas// mtha' yas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam par mgos phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan kun dga'i thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang 'byor rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang gis// dngos grub rnam gnyis bdud brtsi'i dpal stsol ba// khyab bdag rdo rje sems par gsol ba 'debs// dbang dang gdams pa'i chu bo stong phrag gis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par ngal bso bas// 'phrin las mtsho chen ngang gis gang gyur pa'i// chos kyi gter chen khyod la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bstod pa'i legs tshogs ci mchis pas// bstan 'dzin 'jig rten khams su 'byon pa dang*// dge 'dun thams cad mchog du mthun pa dang*// dge ba'i bshes rnams rtag par zhabs brtan shog

/rnam dpyod gser gyi yu ba la brten pa'i// kun dga'i phrin las nor bu'i gdugs dkar ni// gzhan phan rdo rje'i tog gis nyer mdzes pa'i// dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang por bstod byed pa// shākya'i gsung rabs mang po'i nags khrod na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi// 'gyur khug stong phrag ldan pa'i khu byug zhig /snyan ngags dbyangs kyi phreng ba de ltar len// zhes pa 'di ni kong ston mgon po rgyan gyi kha 'don du bya ba'i rim pa nyid du bskul ba'i ngor bgyis te/ bla ma de nyid kyis zhabs rdul gus pas len pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gtsang g.yas ru sa'i thig le sgrub chen khyung po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ gdul bya nye bar bskyangs pa'i gnas su sbyor ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //kha char byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ rmad byung bsod nams chen po'i dge legs kyi// rgyal ba gnyis pa rin chen bzang po yi// chos kyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i mtshan ldan pa// mkhan po chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// kun spyod rnam dag bsod nams sog pa'i zhing*// gzhan phan lhun grub rgyal ba kun gyi sras// zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa'i thugs mnga' ba// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sngon goms dbang gi ting 'dzin nyes pas dben// gnang bkag mkhyen pas bcas la mi 'da' zhing*// dul ba'i dpal gyis 'gro 'di 'dul mkhas pa// gnas brtan chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag bde'i don du dag pa'i zhing yang spong*// gzhan bde'i don du mnar med bar yang 'jug /bdag gzhan brje ba'i lam la dbang 'byor pa'i// rgyal sras chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mthong ba'i mod la dwang ba 'dren pa'i sku// ring du bsten na dngos su grub kun gyi gzhi// ji tsam brtag kyang yon tan phung po can// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// bde stong chen po'i dpal la rtag rol zhing*// gang shar lha skur gzigs pa'i dpal yon can// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gyis mtho ba'i// chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu la// zhabs kyi rdul phreng rtag par ngal gso ba'i// srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// rigs can rnams la rang rang rjes mthun pa'i// theg pas rgyud sbyangs sngags gzhung zab mo'i don// legs par bshad pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// lhag par bya ba mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// dag pa'i zhing gzhan skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs// lhag par dgongs tshe rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga'i mtshan can dkyil 'khor 'khor lor bcas// mngon sum gzigs nas gshegs la gsol ba 'debs// de tshe brgya byin zhu yi gur khang du// dri zhim spos dang yid 'ong rol mo'i sgra// nam mkha' 'gengs byed dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas// khyod zhabs gus pas bsten la gsol ba 'debs// sgyu ma'i sku nyid mkha' la gshegs nus kyang*// zhabs rdul len rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir// sku gdung ring srel rnam 'phrul brgya phrag rnams// 'gro ba'i dpal du shar la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar khyod la gsol ba btab pa la// skye ba kun du khyed zhabs gus bsten cing*// phan mdzad thugs rje ldan pa'i bstan pa la// rab tu byung zhing khrims la gnas gyur cig

/ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// gcig tu gus pas rang la len byed cing*// bdag gi phan bde'i dngos po ci mchis pa// ma rnams kun la so sor smin gyur cig /de nas theg mchog ston pa'i bla ma la// dri med dbang dang rnam dag rgyud sde'i don// legs par mnos nas rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces bya ba 'di ni dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rje mus chen la bstod pa yon tan rjes su dran pa'i gter// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpal 'bar bas// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang bsgyur rgyal tshab dam pa'i mtshan ldan pa// dpal ldan phrin las bzang por mgos phyag 'tshal// dkon mchog gsum dngos rje btsun bla ma la// rigs brgya'i bdag por gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// rnam rgyal zung 'jug mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku// nges par mngon du mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// nam yang dkon pa mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub rnam gnyis rgyal ba nyid las brnyes// mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// nyin mtshan g.yel ba med la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog mngon par rtogs pa'i dpal yon gyis// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i dpung tshogs las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan dpal mnga' ba// phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thun mong thun mong min pa'i 'dul ba yis// nyid kyi sku gsung thugs gsum btsun por byas// mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho yis// rnam dpyod bang mdzod phongs pa kun dang bral// stong nyid blo dang rgyal sras spyod pa yis// sems dpa' chen por gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis dang por mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams bsten// lung dang rigs pa'i gnas rnams legs par sbyangs// bar du grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa las// thun mong min pa'i gdams pa rgya cher mnos// tha mar dam pas bsngags pa'i sman ljongs su// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// pha rol phyin pa'i mdo gzhung dgongs 'grel bcas// legs par sbyangs shing rgya chen spyod pa'i phyogs// nges par chub nas srid dang zhi ba yi// pha rol phyin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo dang rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs rnams// slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung las nges chub nas// chos dang chos min so sor 'byed pa yi// rigs pa'i lam chen mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo// bas mtha'i gnas su mchog gi dngos grub la// lhag pa gzhol bas dben pa lhur mdzad kyang*// thugs rjes bsdus pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la// phrin las lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dang por rgya cher thos pas yid sbyangs shing*// bar du gdams pa'i bdud rtsis yid 'khul nas// tha mar rtse gcig sgrub la g.yel med shog

/gang shar snang stong sgyu ma lha yi sku// tshul bzhin yid byed mi 'gyur bde ba'i bdag /rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang de thob shog /ces rgyal sras mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas smon lam gdab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yon tan rjes su dran pa'i gter zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa de nyid kyi gsung las thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa du ma'i bka' drin nye bar thob pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ nye bar sbyar ba yin no// ༈ //rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug la bstod pa// ༄// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang*// rje btsun kun dga'i chos kyi rgyal srid la// lhag par dbang bsgyur bslab gsum nor gyis phyug /phrin las bzang po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kun spyod rnam dag dwang ba 'dren pa'i sku// gzhan phan la dga' dam chos sgrogs pa'i gsung*// thugs rje'i dbang phyug dul ba'i dpal mnga' ba// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo// kun kyang thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas// thun mong min pa'i chos kyi dga' ston mchog /dri med dbang bzhis smin cing rgyud phyug nas// grol lam ston pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus chos kyi bdag po kun dga'i mtshan// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po gang gi gsung*// 'bral med bsten pas chos kyi dbang phyug mchog /legs par brnyes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshul khrims rnam gsum bcas pa'i rwa ba las// nam yang mi 'da' thub pa'i ring lugs 'dzin// byams dang snying rjes 'gro mang bsdud mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// snyan rgyud gdams pa'i chu bo stong phrag gis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par ngal gso nas// rnam mang gdul bya'i rgud pa sel mkhas pa// chos kyi rgya mtshor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// mi dge'i bshes dang log pa'i lam spangs te// zab lam tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// dges shing rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/thun mong min pa'i chos kyi gnad thos nas// lam gyi rtsa ba yang dag dge ba'i bshes// khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i skur mthong nas// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa 'di ni dbon po kun dga' dpal bzang gis kha ton du bya ba'i ngor/ dge slong shākya mchog ldan gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ //bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ blo gros mngon mtho'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar// mkhyen rab dbang phyug legs pa'i 'byung gnas gang*// tshul khrims rnam dag rgyal mtshan mthon po'i dpal// bzang po'i gdugs dkar 'dzin der mgos phyag 'tshal// blo gros rab yangs mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug can// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag legs pa'i 'byung gnas che// rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal// bzang po'i phrin las can der mgos phyag 'tshal// 'gro mang byams pa'i bdud rtsis legs skyong zhing*// thugs rje'i gsung gis gdul bya'i dbul ba sel// nam yang byang chub thugs kyi ngang tshul can// brtse chen bla ma khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// chos tshul re re'i de nyid gsung ba na// shes byed brgya yis 'thad pa dang bcas pas// yid la 'bab cing rna bar rab snyan par// gsung mkhas smra ba'i nyi mar mgos phyag 'tshal// dri med lung gi glog phreng stong 'khyug pa'i// yang dag rigs pa'i sprin gyi rnga dbyangs kyis// log smra'i snying la 'jigs pa che bskyed nas// chos kyi char chen stsol la mgos phyag 'tshal// sdeb sbyor rgyan gyi gangs ri las 'ongs shing*// mngon brjod rlabs kyi phreng bas nyer mdzes pa'i// rtsom pa'i chu yis thub bstan yid bzhin mtsho// legs par spel ba khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// zab yangs blo gros chos kun mkhyen pa'i thugs// tshul khrims dbang phyug ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i sku// legs pa'i 'byung gnas dam chos ston pa'i gsung*// rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod 'os der phyag 'tshal// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gang thugs rgya mtsho ji bzhin gang ba dang*// khyod gsung lha yi rnga bzhin 'doms pa dang*// nyid sku lhun po bzhin du zhabs brtan shog/

//maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu ru we/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i dbang po sa skya pa// rje btsun brtse ba chen po'i gdung bzung nas// phrin las dbang por gyur pa'i blo gros kyis// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de la 'dud// gsung rab mang du mkhyen pa'i blo gros can// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la thugs gzhol bas// dben pa'i gnas su rang rgyud smin mdzad nas// gzhan phan lhun gyis grub pa de la 'dud// rang bzhin lhan skyes gdod nas dag pa'i sku// bde chen ye shes sgrib kun bral ba'i gsung*// yon tan kun rdzogs chos dbyings rdo rje'i thugs// ma lus rigs brgya'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs// kun rdzob chos kun ma dag snang bar mkhyen// ji snyed chos kun nyams kyi ngang nas gsal// dag snang chos dbyings ngang nas tshogs gnyis po// bskrun mdzad rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs// skal bzang slob ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi po// rang bzhin lhun grub sku bzhir ngo sprad nas// dbang bzhis smin cing lam bzhis grol mdzad pa'i// khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs// dag dang ma dag snang ba ji snyed pa// snang mkhan rang gi sems su mkhyen gyur nas// sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' bral gzigs gyur pa// zung 'jug lta ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// 'khor ba'i nyams kyis chad pa'i g.yang sa spangs// myang 'das nyams kyis rtag pa'i mthar kun bsal// zung 'jug ngang nas sgo gsum skyon bral ba// yang dag spyod pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// ji snyed chos kun gsal ba'i ngo bor gzigs// ji lta'i don la rtog med thugs su chud// gsal stong nyams su myong ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// zung 'jug sgom pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i sku// bde chen ye shes mchog tu 'bar ba'i gsung*// 'gros chen rnam bzhi dbu mar thim pa'i thugs// 'bras bu'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje chos skyong bran bzhin bskul ba'i sku// gong ma'i chos kyi bang mdzod 'dzin pa'i gsung*// zab mo'i lam gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i thugs// phrin las dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bsod nams kyis// ma dag snang ba 'khrul par shes pa dang*// nyams kyi snang ba sgyu mar shes pa dang*// dag snang lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs// ma dag snang bas yid 'byung skye ba dang*// nyams kyi snang bas byams brtse 'phel ba dang*// dag pa'i snang bas sems can rnams don du// nges 'byung gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyu rgyud sbyang gzhi'i gnas su shes pa dang*// thabs rgyud sbyong byed ngo bor rtogs pa dang*// nyes kun zad cing yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i// 'bras rgyud lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa rang sar dag pa dang*// blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa'i spyod pa dang*// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i lta ba dang*// zung 'jug grub mtha' snyogs par byin gyis rlobs// gzhan dbang lus la rten 'brel 'grig gyur nas// kun btags gzung 'dzin bral ba'i lta ba yis// ma rig mun pa bral ba'i chos can yang*// yongs grub longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// ces pa 'di dad pa dang ldan pa mang pos bskul ba'i ngor rje de nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi bdud rtsi nye bar blangs pa/

dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //bha wan+tu// ༈ //stag lung ka bzhi pa rin chen bkra shis kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dngos grub kyi snye ma// ༄// swasti/ rang gi bla ma dus 'khor pa chen po la bstod pa/ sen mo'i dmar 'od nyi ma dang*// mdzod spu'i 'od dkar zla ba yis// mtshan yang nyin mo ltar mdzad pa// dus kyi 'khor lo'i mkhyen brtse la// phyag 'tshal khyod ni rdzogs sangs rgyas// mang po'i thugs kyi nying khu mchog /kho nar ma zad rig pa'i gnas// ma tshang med kun khyod la mnga'// tshangs pas dran dang bha ra tas// sbyar ba'i bstan bcos la zhen pa'i// khengs ldan dag kyang dregs pa'i chang*// skyugs par byas nas khyod drung du// gus par lhags pa ma yin nam// de phyir 'phags pa'i yul dag tu// phyi rol rgyu skar mkhan 'ga' la// 'gram pa'i chu gter ldang mi dgos// sangs rgyas grub mtha' rnam bzhi po// so so'i rnam gzhag ma 'khrul ba// khyod la snga phyir shing rta yi// srol 'byed gzhan la rag ma las// pha rol phyin tshul zab pa dang*// rgya chen mtha' dag khyod kyis bsdus// stong nyid snying rje can tshul gyi// chos 'ga' gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// stong nyid snying rje tha dad du// dbye nus min pa khyod la mnga'// de yi rnam dbye tha dad du// dbye bas khyod gzhung khong mi chud// shing rta'i srol du ma grags pa'i// nges pa'i don zab khyod la mnga'// de mngon byed pa'i thabs mchog kyang*// gzhan du ma grags khyod kyis bshad// khengs ldan gsang sngags pa gzhan la// ma grags phyi nang gzhan gsum mkhyen// rnam shes blo la phyi nang du// gang snang gzung 'dzin kun rdzob pa// ye shes nyid la'ang de ltar du// ci ltar gzhan te don dam par// ston mdzad bla ma mchog de la// phyi nang gzhan gsum phyag dang yang*// de gsum mchod par phul nas yang*// phyi nang gzhan gsum dngos grub yang*// yang dang yang du gsol bar 'debs// rin chen las grub dus 'khor lo'i// khang bzang yid 'ong nyams dga' bar// drug brgyas lhag pa'i stong phrag gi

/bkra shis ya mtshan ltad mo ni// chos dbyings ye shes 'ja' tshon gyi// ri mo ji bzhin rnam bkra ba// sgrib thogs med par der bcug nas// dbang bdun bskur nas thun mong gi /grub pa dag dang rgyud 'grel gyi// bshad nyan rdzogs pa de stsal nas// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang bzhi po// slob mar byed dang slob dpon du// byed pa'i tshul kun mthar phyin par// stsal nas bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi// rdzogs par gnang ba'i bla ma mchog /rin chen bkra shis zhes bya ba'i// mtshan can de yis pha rol du// phyin pa'i dka' bzhi thog mar sbyangs// de nas bu ston lo tsā ba'i// grwa sar rgyud sde rnam bzhi yi// lag len cho ga ma lus mkhyen// skabs der e waṃ chos kyi rje// kun dga'i mtshan la lam 'bras dang*// rdor phreng kṛ ya saṃ ḍa zhus// bu ston lo tsā'i gsung rabs dang*// chos rje bla mas mdzad chos kyang*// de sras shes rab mtshan can dang*// sku zhang chos rjer grags la gsan// de ltar bslabs sbyangs mthar phyin pa// mdzad nas mkhyen dang grub pa des// rig pa'i 'byung gnas 'phan yul du// che mnyan grags can mang po dang*// mkhas btsun slob ma bgrang yas la// dbang dang rgyud 'grel gdams ngag sogs// gsang sngags chos kyi char chen phab// rang rang rgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i// dam chos 'dod pas gdungs rnams la// re 'dod yid bzhin mtsho chen po// rang rang lhag bsam dang mthun par// mgyogs par khengs mdzad bla ma mchog /yid bzhin rin chen gter mnga' ba'i// bkra shis ma lus deng 'dir stsol// zhes mtshan rjen pa nas brjod par dka' ba'i sems dpa' chen po stag lung dka' bzhi bar grags pa'i rtogs brjod/ dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //bzad pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// ༄// dam chos 'khor lo sgyur ba'i dpal mnga' ba// 'gro bzang dbang po stong gi spyi bo na// rnam grol gdugs dkar g.yo ba rgyal ba'i sras// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni bskal pa du ma'i snga rol du// 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i dam chos khur can de// blo gros shing rta'i khri la legs drangs nas// srid mtsho sgrol bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor lo bzhi yi dpal la dbang 'byor pas// thub pa'i brtul shugs rdzogs par legs blangs nas// thos bsam sgom pas dus gsum rgyal ba yi// thugs kyi bang mdzod 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// kun spyod rnam dag gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin// phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' che// gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gter la gsol ba 'debs// rlabs chen shugs drag rigs pa'i dpung tshogs kyis// nyes bshad dgra sde'i tshogs rnams pham mdzad nas// gzhung lugs mi 'byed bzhi la dbang 'byor ba// thub pa'i rgyal srid skyong la gsol ba 'debs// phun tshogs tshogs gnyis rta ljang rol ba'i rtser// gsung rabs rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyas// legs bshad bshad pa'i 'od stong g.yo ba la// lus can kun gyi mgon la gsol ba 'debs// khyod ni blo gros yangs pa'i dge legs kyis// snang stong skabs gsum dbang po'i lam yangs por// bde stong sgyu ma'i gar gyis dgyes rol zhing*// gang shar lha skur gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// dri med dbang dang rnam dag rgyud bshad dang*// gdams pa'i lus rdzogs ngag gzengs 'thon po yis// sbas pa'i don rnams dngos su ston mdzad pa'i// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so skye ba thams cad du// mkhyen brtse thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa dang*// mngon par rnam sangs rgyas pa'i dang po la// dam chos bdud rtsis tshim par byin gyis brlobs// gnas skabs su'ang lus dang longs spyod kun// ltos pa med par khyed la rab phul nas// smin byed dbang dang grol byed rim gnyis kyis// srid pa'i rgya mtsho skems par byin gyis brlobs// tshe 'di la yang dal 'byor gru bzang 'di// rgya chen thos pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal nas// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyi// sgom byung bdud rtsis tshim par byin gyis brlobs// dge ba 'dis kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa// gting zab 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol byed pa'i// don gnyis pha mtha' son pa'i bcom ldan 'das// rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlobs// skye dang skye bar khyed sku ci 'dra zhing*// zhing khams gang du byang chub ma thob bar// bar chad med par rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// dwang ba'i sems kyis bka' bzhin 'grub gyur cig/

//dge'o// ༈ //rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs pa'i cha shas brjod cing 'dud pa blo gsal gyi mgul rgyan zhes bya ba// ༄// rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo// skal bzang skye dgu'i mgon gyur chos kyi rje// zhabs kyi chu skyes 'gro ba'i cod paṇa la// 'bral med reg cing brtse bas nyer dgongs te// yang dag rigs pa'i lam mchog myur du stsol// dge legs kun gyi rin chen 'byung gnas der// rmad byung legs byas ba dan rab bskyod pas// phyogs las rnam rgyal dbang gi rgyal pos mdzes// phyogs dus kun du dge mtshan ster la 'dud// nges 'byung shugs kyis thub bstan mkha' la 'phags// dri med bslab gsum dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs// drang srong mchog gi brtul zhugs 'od brgya 'dzin// tshangs spyod ri bong mtshan mas brgyan la 'dud// yang dag rigs bzhi'i bzhon pas legs drangs pa'i// legs bshad ngag gi tsha zer drwa ba yis// lus can rna ba'i pad+mo ldan pa dag /yid kyi 'dab brgya rdzogs par mdzad la 'dud// rlabs chen shugs drag rigs pa'i dpung tshogs kyis// nyes bshad dgra sde'i tshogs rnams pham byas nas// gzhung lugs gling chen bzhi la dbang bsgyur ba'i// dam chos 'khor los sgyur la gus pas 'dud// rgyal sras bye ba'i dbus na mkhyen pa'i gter// 'phags pa'i yul na rnam 'grel bdag po dang*// gangs can ljongs 'dir rigs smra'i dbang phyug ces// grags pa'i gdugs dkar 'dzin la gus pas 'dud// mang thos chu gter che las legs 'thon pa'i// rab gsal gzhung brgya'i dgongs 'grel chu bo stong*// ma bshad zlos pa'i dri mas ma 'dres par// rigs pa'i lam du sbyin mdzad de la 'dud// rab dkar thugs rje brten zhing yangs pa'i khyon// lhag bsam dpal gyi phun tshogs ci yang bskrun// mtha' yas phan bde'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i// rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i gos can de la 'dud// mgon po khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho las// dad pa'i snyim pas cha tsam legs blangs te// blo ldan 'ga'i mgul par phul ba yis// thob pa'i dge ba rab yangs dri med des// theg pa mchog ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos tshul ma lus dang*// dal 'byor mtshan mas mdzes pa'i lus bzang dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig

/yang dag don gyi lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// legs sbyar tshig gi bzhin mdangs rab gsal 'di// dad pa'i chags ldan tshul khrims seng ge yi// re ba rdzogs phyir shākya zhes pas sprul// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sh+lau ka dang pos rab byed 'di'i spyi'i dgos 'brel bshad/ gnyis pas bstod yul ngos bzung zhing bstod pa mdor bstan/ gsum pas zla ba dang mtshungs par bshad pa'i sgo nas btsun pa lus kyi yon tan bshad/ mkhas pa'i yon tan ni 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yin pas/ bzhi pas nyi ma dang mtshungs pa'i sgo nas 'chad pa ngag gi yon tan bshad/ lnga pa dang drug pas brtsod pa ngag gi yon tan bshad/ de yang lnga pas 'khor lo sgyur rgyal dang 'dra bar ji ltar rtsod pa'i tshul dang brtsod pa'i 'bras bu gnyis bshad/ drug pas yongs su grags pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'i sgo nas rtsod pa la ji ltar dbang ba'i tshul bshad/ bdun pa klu dang mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rtsom pa dang*/ brgyad pas sa gzhi dang mtshungs pa'i sgo nas bzang ba yid kyi yon tan bshad/ dgu pas rab byed 'di ji ltar brtsam pa dang*/ brtsams pa las dge ba thob tshul bshad/ bcu pas rigs pa'i dbang phyug 'di nyid dang tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral ba'i smon lam mtshan dang sbyar ba'i 'phros dang bcas pas 'jug bsdus so// zhes pa 'di ni dam pa de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can tshul khrims seng ges nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rigs pa smra bar khas 'che ba shākya mchog ldan gyis me mo yos kyi lo la gnas nang zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// ༈ //rje stag lung thang pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa nges don gtam gyi mchod dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ in+d+rā bud+dhi'i thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /bkra shis nyin mo'i dpal gyis byin rlabs pas// rigs gzhung kun sbyangs nges par grub dbang po// srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// ngag dbang kun gyi bla na nges bzhugs shing*// grags pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na gsal// thugs rje'i phyag gis 'gro kun gong nas gong*// 'dren mdzad chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mthon po'i rigs 'khrungs rnam dpyod ngang gis gsal// lhag pa'i lha grub ngag gi dbang por gyur// rlabs chen mdzad pas grags pa'i gdugs dkar po// g.yo mdzad mkhyen brtse'i gter la gsol ba 'debs// dang po dge ba'i bshes dang yi dam bsnyen// bar du ngag dbang mkhas pa'i go 'phang bzung*// tha mar dben pa'i gnas su grub mdzad pa// grags pa'i dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sngon tshe 'od gsal grub pa'i dbang po zhig

/chos kyi gdung 'dzin chen po'i rgyud 'khrungs nas// gzhon nur gyur pa'i rol rtsed mdzad pa na// gang shar sgyu mar gzigs la gsol ba 'debs// ma 'khrul lta ba'i gnas la gdeng thob cing*// ma nyams thabs lam tshul la dbang 'byor pas// gzhan la med pa'i chos kyi lam chen po// 'dzin mdzad dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// byang chub thugs mchog rgyal sras spyod pa la// nam yang mi 'gong bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni// chos 'dul bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' ba// mkhas btsun rgyal ba'i sras la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi bgyi ba ci mdzad pa// rgyal ba'i bstan dang sems can don 'ba' zhig /nges par dgongs pa'i phrin las bzang po yis// gangs can nyin mor mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// 'chal tshul dri bral sgrub pa'i 'od stong gis// sgrub rgyud skar ma'i nang na cher gsal bas// bka' rgyud bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad pa// kun gyis bkur bar 'os la gsol ba 'debs// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang spros pa kun bral ba// 'gyur med bde chen ye shes kyis rtogs nas// bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i sku// nges par mngon du mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// sbyor ba'i dus su spros pa'i tshogs kun bral// dngos gzhi'i tshe na cir yang mi dmigs pa'i// 'dzin med ngang nas phyag rgya cher rol pa// lta ba'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs// rjes thob spros pa'i 'char tshul ji snyed pa// snang stong sgyu ma'i rnam rol du gzigs nas// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la spro mdzad pa// spyod pa'i dbang phyug nyid la gsol ba 'debs// rig gnas ma lus mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'gro ba ma lus brtse ba'i phyag gis bzung*// phrin las bzang pos bstan pa gnas pa dang*// 'gro don 'ba' zhig dgongs la gsol ba 'debs// rjod byed gtsang zhing brjod bya'i don rnams gsal// rna bar snyan zhing snying la nges par sim// nyan po'i blo la nges par ster mkhas pa'i// 'chad la 'gran med khyod la gsol ba 'debs// mdo lung rgya mtsho'i 'jings nas nyer blangs shing*// rnam dpyod spobs pa'i rta brgyas nges drangs pa'i// lugs ngan pham byed rigs pa'i nyi ma yis// gzhan blo'i mun pa sel la gsol ba 'debs// nang don rig pa'i gangs ri las 'ongs shing*// sdeb sbyor lugs brgya'i lam chen nyer brgyud nas// tha snyad gzhung brgya'i spu phreng mdzes 'dzin pa// rtsom pa'i char chen 'bebs la gsol ba 'debs// tshul khrims rnam dag sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung*// gzhung lugs kun mkhyen grub pa'i sa la bzhugs// ma 'ongs lung ston rdo rje chos skyong rnams// bran bzhin bkol mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs// dbyangs can dga' ba'i legs bshad gtam chen pos// khyod blo'i bang mdzod phongs pa kun dang bral// rang rigs gong ma'i dpag bsam 'dod 'jo las// bdud rtsi'i dpal mnga' khyod la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar khyod la gus pas gsol 'debs shing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi// lta spyod log par gyur rnams mthol bgyis nas// skye ba kun du rjes su 'dzin gyur cig

/dus gsum dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*// zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// bsam yas 'gro ba'i don du zhabs brtan par// gsol ba 'debs so 'gro kun byin gyis rlobs// dbon rgyud gangs ri lta bur 'brel ba dang*// bu slob chu bo bzhin du 'bab pa dang*// phrin las rgya mtsho ji bzhin gang ba yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje stag lung thang pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nges don gtam gyi mchod dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ phyag chen pa dpal ldan chos bzang zhes bya bas bskul pa'i ngor/ rje de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gyur pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// ༈ //rje dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bgrang yas kyis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par gnas bcas nas// phrin las chu bo stong phrag 'bebs mdzad pa// chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rin chen bsngags par 'os// gnas brtan chen po lam phran bstan nyid kyi// rnam 'phrul dngos gyur dpal ldan rin chen las// rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs nas nyer gsum par// bslab sbyangs mthar phyin sgrub la'ang brtson par mdzad// de nas bzung ste rang lo don drug pa// mthar phyin bar du lo grangs gcig tsam yang*// bar chad med par dam pa'i chos gsungs pas// slob ma'i tshogs rnams smin grol mdzad la 'dud// 'dul mdo 'grel par bcas dang gleng gzhi dang*// sngags chog gong ma'i rnam bshad rgyas pa kun// ma tshang med par zla ba gsum re la// rdzogs par gsung ba'i dam bca' mthar phyin mdzad// mdzod 'grel yongs rdzogs 'grel bshad rnam gnyis po// mchims dang sne'u pa'i bshad srol gyis brgyan pa// zla ba gnyis res tshang bar 'chad pa yi// dam bca' mthar phyin de la gegs mi mnga'// de 'dra de ni gnas brtan chen po yi// gsung bzhin skyo ngal med par goms bgyis pas// thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i byin rlabs zhes// dus mthar gsungs pa de la snying nas dad// gang gi 'khor du dge slong tshogs 'dus pa// dam chos 'dul ba'i phyag len snying po mchog

/gzhi gsum rnam gzhag snyung gnas cho ga yis// kun spyod gtsang mar mdzad pa de la dad// khyod sku btsun par mthong ba tsam gyis shes// khyod gsung yangs par gsung rab thos pas go /khyod thugs bzang bar ring du brten pas shes// mkhas btsun bzang po'i go 'phang mnyes khyod tsam// rang gis bzung ba'i chos kyi grwa chen las// ma g.yos bshad pa'i rnam grangs de lta bu// mdzad po gzhan dag yod dam 'ga' med na// khyod la lhag par skyabs su mchi min nam// khyed cag bla mar bcas pa'i sgrin 'grus kyis// bstan la lhag par bsams pa'i go cha 'di// nus ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum pos// 'bral pa med par gyon dgos ma yin nam// mthong bas 'jig rten 'das par go khyod nyid// bsams pas rgyal sras chen por de ring shes// bstan pa'i bya ba zab cing rgya che bar// mdzad la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar 'dun zhing dad pa'i dge legs kyis// bdag kyang rgyal ba'i sras kyi brtul phod dang*// nam yang mi 'bral thos bsam lag pa yis// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par 'dzin byed shog /'di ni gro sa'i dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen la bstod pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //skyor lung mkhan po chos rgyal dpal bzangs la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dge legs chos kyi khang bzang rab bzung nas// bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i rgyal mtshan ni// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i rnga sgra can// kun gyis mchod par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// dam chos tshul bzhin 'doms mdzad dge ba'i bshes// gzhan phan 'ba' zhig dgongs pa rgyal ba'i sras// don gnyis lhun grub sa gsum 'gro ba'i dpal// blo bzang chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// zab mo'i chos la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' zhing*// rgyal ba'i gsung la sbyangs pa mi dman pas// gangs can bstan pa'i dpal du shar gyur pa// kun bzang chos kyi nyi mar gsol ba 'debs// dam chos snying po 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog

/phyogs las rnam rgyal byang chub sems dpa' che// rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i dpal mnga' ba// bskal bzang bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs// zab dang rgya che'i chos rnams mang du gsan// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin tshol la gzhol// zung 'jug mtshan ma med pa'i dpal 'bar ba// mkhas btsun bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// kun gyis bkur ba'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i sku// dam pa'i chos rnams ji bzhin 'chad pa'i gsung*// nam yang rgyal ba'i sras kyi thugs mnga' ba// 'gro kun bzang por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bstod pas bdag dang 'gro ba kun// 'jig rten chos dang sdig pa'i grogs spangs nas// dam pa'i chos dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// tshe rabs 'di dang phyi mar rjes 'dzin shog /ces pa 'di ni/ mkhan chen gdan sa pa'i gsung gis nye bar bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ rje btsun de nyid kyi slob 'bangs su gyur pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du nye bar sbyar nas phul ba yin no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //skyor mo lung pa bsod nams tshul khrims la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ sku gsung thugs kyi bgyi ba ci mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i don dang thub pa'i bstan pa la// lhag par dgongs pa'i bsod nams rlabs po ches// khyod blo'i bang mdzod 'dzin pa de la 'dud// nyan thos tshul khrims bcas pa'i 'khor yug can// byang sems tshul khrims rang bzhin nyes pa las// rnam grol ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dbang po ni// 'dul 'dzin chen po'i grags thob de la 'dud// dge ba'i chos bsdud sems can don mdzad cing*// bsod nams lus rdzogs nyes spyod kun sdom pa'i// tshul khrims rgyan gyis nam yang brjid chags pa// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i dbang po de la 'dud// nyin mo dam chos 'chad las mi g.yel zhing*// mtshan mo so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan gyis// 'dod las chags bral stong nyid mngon sum du// gzigs mdzad dpa' bo de la gus phyag 'tshal// nyer lnga'i lo nas brgyad bcu rtsa gsum bar// 'dul mdo 'grel par bcas dang mngon pa'i mdzod// 'grel bcas tshang ba brgya dang brgyad re re// gsungs pas bstan pa yongs su bzung la 'dud// mthong ba'i mod la byang chub sems dpar mtshon// ring du brten na rang rgyud ngang gis thul// gdul bya'i tshogs rnams rgyal ba'i sras su yang*// 'dren mdzad slob dpon chen pos rjes 'dzin shog

/skyor mo lung pa bsod nams tshul khrims la bstod pa'o// ༈ //paṇa chen blo brtan bzhi pa la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dpal ldan blo brtan bzhi pa yi// ya mtshan kun gyis bsngags 'os pa// gang gi zhabs rdul len bdag kyang*// sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o// khyod sku yum gyi lhums zhugs tshe// blo gros brtan par mtshan gsol zhes// byang chub rtse mos lung bstan par// mdzad la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// dpang lo chen po bsams bzhin du// 'khrungs par khyod kyi slob ma'i tshogs// chos rjes 'brang rnams dogs med par// ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhon nu'i dus nas rig pa yi// gnas phran lnga po tshegs med par// mkhyen pas de dag kun gyi yang*// 'grel mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyad par dpang los sgra tshad la// rtsal du ston pa'i srol bzung nas// sgra tshad dgongs 'grel brtsom pa'i tshogs// mang por mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa'i dbang po red mda' pa'i// drung du sde snod kun sbyangs nas// dka' bcu smra ba'i mchog tu yang*// lhag par bsngags la phyag 'tshal lo// lo chen nam mkha' bzang po dang*// 'jam dbyangs ral gri'i zhabs pad las// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol du// byon par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gshin rje bshes dang chos skyong gi /las tshogs mang po'i mthu grub pas// bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i rtsal thob par// kun gyis bsngags la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can ljongs su mkhas pa yi// grags thob gyur pa mang po dang*// 'bel ba'i gtam gyis smra ba'i rgyan// rigs par mdzad pa phyag 'tshal lo// bod yul dbus su brda sprod dang*// snyan ngags gzhung lugs dar mdzad cing*// dbang dang gdams pas slob ma'i tshogs// bgrang yas smin cing mkhas mdzad pa// khyod kyi zhabs rdul dri ma med// sa chen skyong mdzad che rnams dang*// dus der mkhas pa'i grags thob pa// kun gyis len mdzad la phyag 'tshal// de ltar dbang gis smin mdzad cing*// sde snod chos dang tha snyad kyi// gtsug lag thos pa'i slob dpon la// bstod pas de yi gnas thob shog

/bo dong ba paṇa chen blo brtan bzhi pa/ snye thang chos rdzong pa la bstod pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje la bstod pa// ༄// kun spyod rnam dag dwang ba 'dren pa'i sku// gzhan phan la dga' dam chos sgrog pa'i gsung*// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs mnga' ba// phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zhi ba'i tshul khrims rang bzhin nyes pas dben// rnam dag khrims tshul bcas pa'i rwa ba la// nam yang mi 'da' thub pa'i ring lugs pa// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa'i shugs kyis 'gro mang dbang du bsdud// thugs rje'i stobs kyis gdul bya'i dbul ba sel// rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa// rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rong ston rje'i// zab yangs chos kyi khri la dbang sgyur bas// mtha' yas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ dpal ldan kun dga'i thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang 'byor rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzangs kyis// dngos grub rnam gnyis bdud rtsi'i dpal stsol ba// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// dbang dang gdams pa'i chu bo stong phrag gis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par ngal gsos nas// phrin las mtsho chen ngang gis gang gyur pa// chos kyi gter chen khyed la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bstod pa'i legs tshogs ci mchis pa// bstan 'dzin 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// dge 'dun thams cad mchog tu mthun pa dang*// dge ba'i bshes rnams rtag par zhabs brtan shog/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan la bstod pa dam pa'i chos la nges pa bskyed pa'i rim pa// ༄// na mo dzī na pu dra ye/ glang ri thang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas la bstod pa/ dam pa'i chos la nges pa bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/

'chi med dbang po'i gtsug rgyan nor bu yis// zhabs zung rtag par len la gegs med pa// glang ri thang par grags pa rgyal pa'i sras// sprul pas gzhan don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// blo gros dbang phyug tshul khrims bum bzang 'dzin// phyogs las rnam rgyal mdo dang sngags kyi mdzod// mtha' yas dge mtshan du ma'i dpal mnga' ba// blo chen phrin las bzang por gsol ba 'debs// zag bcas dngos kun sbu ba'i phreng ba dang*// srid pa'i bde ba dug gi ro dngar ltar// nges par gzigs nas gtan gyi bde ba la// 'gro kun 'dren mdzad khyed la gsol ba 'debs// zhi ba'i tshul khrims rang bzhin nyes pas dben// rnam dag tshul khrims bcas pa'i khor yug can// chos 'dul bstan pa'i rtsa bar gzigs gyur pa// ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum gzigs nas// thugs rje'i phyag gis 'gro kun 'dren la brtson// theg mchog gtam gyi dga' ston nyer spel ba// rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por gsol ba 'debs// ma nor theg chen chos kyi snying po la// nges shes gting nas rnyed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten la g.yel med pa// lam gyi rtsa bar mkhyen la gsol ba 'debs// tha mal snang zhen bral ba lha yi sku// mtha' bral bde chen 'doms pa sngags kyi gsung*// zung 'jug rig pa 'dzin pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// bsrung bya'i dam tshig srog las gces par bzung*// ci mdzad de kun dpag yas 'gro ba'i don// nam yang nyams len gnad la 'khrul med pa// dam pas bsngags par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// sgo gsum nyes pas ma gos btsun pa'i sku// theg chen chos lugs mkhyen pa mkhas pa'i gsung*// gzhan don 'ba' zhig dgongs pa bzang po'i thugs// mang po'i 'dren par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// bshad bya'i chos las 'khrul pa med pa'i thugs// 'chad byed ngag la thogs pa med pa'i gsung*// nyan pos bltas na nges shes 'dren pa'i sku// blo bzang smra ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// de ltar dge ba'i bshes la bsnyen byas nas// gang blo chos su 'gro ba'i gdams pa yis// 'jig rten 'di la sred pas ma sbags par// sgo gsum dge la gzhol bar byin gyis brlobs// dam chos lam du slongs pa'i gdams pa yis// sdug bsngal rang bzhin nges par bsam byas nas// nges 'byung gting nas skyes pa'i dad pa yis// thar lam tshul bzhin tshol bar byin gyis rlobs// lam gyi gol sa gcod pa'i gdams pa yis// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can rtogs te// zab gsal ye shes bde chen goms gyur nas// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog

/rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// nam yang bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum// bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam can rgya mtsho yis// phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs 'bring gnyug mar gnas pa'i bshes gnyen smon lam bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ dpal mi pham dges pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ glang ri 'od ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du nye bar sbyar ba yin no// ༈ //mkhas grub a mo gha shrī'i bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab 'bum phrag du ma yi// don ston mdzad la chos kyi spyan yangs shing*// yod par smra ba'i tshul khrims gos bzangs can// dpal ldan mkhas btsun bzang por gsol ba 'debs// kun spyod rnam dag dwang ba 'dren pa'i sku// gzhan phan lhun grub dam chos sgrogs pa'i gsung*// rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i thugs mnga' ba// theg gsum bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs// khyed thugs byang chub sems kyi rgya mtshor gnas// mkhyen rabs rgya mtsho khyod blo'i dpal du bzung*// phrin las chu bo stong phrag 'bebs mkhas pa// chos kyi rgya mtshor gus pas gsol ba 'debs// 'jigs med spobs pa shar gyi ri bo'i rtser// don gsal ngag gi shing rtas legs drangs pa'i// legs bshad 'od dkar phyogs brgyar spros pa yis// thub bstan nyin mor byed la gsol ba 'debs// rlabs chen shugs drag rigs pa'i dpung tshogs kyis// nyes bshad dgra sde'i tshogs rnams pham byas nas// gzhung lugs gling chen bzhi la dbang sgyur ba'i// chos kyi rgyal por gus pas gsol ba 'debs// tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung gi rjes 'jug pa'i// phul byung legs bshad rtsom pa'i mthu grub pas// thub dbang bstan pa'i byi dor sgrub mkhas pa'i// shing rta'i srol 'byed chen por gsol ba 'debs// mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal 'dzin kyang*// kun nas khengs pa'i rlabs kyis mi bskyod par// legs bshad chu klung 'bum phrag bsdud la mkhas// mkhas shing dul ba'i rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// phyogs re las tsam gzhung brgya shes pa yi// dregs pas myos pa'i rgol ba stong phrag brgyas// zhabs zung gus pa'i gtsug gis len mdzad pa// gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// byams pa'i shugs kyis 'gro mangs bsdud mkhas shing*// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa spel la mkhas// kun kyang thub pa'i gshegs shul nyams dga' bar// 'khrid mdzad dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// dam chos zol gyis chos brgyad lhur len pa// ring du spangs nas thos bsam sgom pa dang*// bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sku tshe don yod par// mdzad pa'i dpal la gus pas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// nyes pa'i tshogs kun 'gyod pas so sor bshags// rang gzhan dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs// zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don du zhabs brtan par// gsol ba 'debs so dge tshogs ci mchis pa// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang don du bsngo// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs spangs nas// dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// dges bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni/ dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis go bde bar sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yang dag dge ba'i bshes// mdo sngags bstan pa'i dpal du shar gyur nas// skal ldan gdul bya smin zhing grol mdzad pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan chos kyi ngang tshul bzang po yis// sdom gsum bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' zhing*// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi bang mdzod la// dbang 'byor chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// dang por thub pa'i bstan la tshul bzhin zhugs// bar du lung dang rigs pa'i gnas rnams sbyangs// tha mar theg mchog chos kyi khang bzangs su// 'gro mang 'khrid mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis chos kyi gnad rnams gzigs// brtse ba'i phyag gis 'gro kun bdag gir mdzad// bzang po'i mdzad pas bstan pa'i don kho na// lhag par dgongs pa khyod la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas pa'i snang ba gzhan gyis mi 'gong zhing*// btsun pa'i mdangs kyis mang po'i yid rab 'drer// byang chub thugs kyis skal bzang gdul bya rnams// ma lus dbang du bsdud la gsol ba 'debs// thos bsam sgom pas rang gi rgyud grol zhing*// mkhas btsun bzang pos chos kyi gdung bzung nas// mtha' yas bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// brtse chen rgyal ba'i sras la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// yang dag dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul ji snyed pa// 'dzin zhing nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sde snod 'dzin pa dkon mchog chos skyabs kyi kha ton bya ba'i rim pa nyid du bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba yin no//

༈ //bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa'i bstod pa slob ma'i dad pa nyer spel zhes pa bzhugs// ༄// swasti/ rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la mi lhod cing*// zab gsal gnyis med ye shes la gzhol bas// dbang dang gdams pa mang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa// phrin las dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// byang chub thugs mchog rgyal sras spyod pa las// nam yang mi 'gong bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni// chos 'dul rgya mtsho'i bcas pas nges bsrung ba// rgyal sras 'dul ba 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// rgya che'i chos la nges par gdeng thob nas// zab mo'i chos kyis skal bzang slob ma'i tshogs// lhag par smin zhing rigs par grol mdzad pa// rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin bcos min dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon// gang gi sku la yul chen nyer bzhi dang*// 'khor lo rnam lnga'i lha tshogs lhun grub nas// 'gro kun byin gyis rlob la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs las grub pa yi// dpal ldan bla ma pho nya gsum gyi bdag /nges par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgoms pas// mchog gi dngos grub stsol la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba'i dge ba gang yod des// rab byung tshul khrims mig 'bras ltar bsrung zhing*// rgyal sras sdom pa srog bzhin gces bzung nas// sngags kyi dam tshig tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /ma dag snang ba 'di kun lha yi sku// gang shar dag pa'i snang ba gnyis med kyi// ye shes dwang du gsal bar goms gyur bas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i go 'phang de thob shog /ces pa 'di ni dge slong mtshams pa'i kha ton du bya ba'i rim pa nyid du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bgyis nas/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blos sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen la bstod pa ni// ༄// na maḥgu rā we/ mtha' yas bsod nams tshogs kyi yid bzhin mtsho// rin chen byang chub sems kyi mdzod bzung nas// ma lus 'gro la phan bde'i dpal stsol ba// dpal ldan sems dpa' chen por gsol ba 'debs// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa'i sku// zab mo'i chos la nges pa rnyed pa'i gsung*// bslab gsum rin chen mang pos bltams pa'i thugs// brtse chen dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// sku yi spyod pa sems can kho na'i don// gsung gi mdzad pa dam pa'i chos kho na// thugs kyi phrin las byang chub sems gnyis las// gzhan du g.yel ba med la gsol ba 'debs// sngon gyi bskal par byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs// sku tshe 'di la rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen// byang chub thugs dang rim gnyis rnal 'byor la// nyams len snying por mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// dag snang can la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku// bar ma rnams la dge ba'i bshes kyi gsung*// phal pa rnams la'ang brtse ba chen po par// ston mdzad brag dkar ba la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro drug pha mar shes pa'i lhag bsam dang*// bdag dang gzhan du brje ba'i nyams len dang*// tshe rabs kun 'bral ba med par shog

/nam yang mi dge'i bshes dang mi 'grogs shing*// dge ba'i bshes kyis rtag tu rjes bzung nas// byang chub sems dang dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi// dga' ston rgyun mi chad pa'i bkra shis shog /de dbon kun dga' rgyal po sogs// skal bzang rnams kyi kha bton du// bya ba'i rim par gsol btab pa// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// //maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //chos rjes gzims khang pa la bstod pa// ༄// 'gro kun dga' mdzad byang chub thugs gnyis kyis// thar ba'i rgyal mtshan mthon po 'dzin pa las// lhag bsam rmad du byung ba'i sems dpa' che// brtse chen bla ma khyod la gsol ba 'debs// ༈ //rting khebs chos sde'i slob dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ phan bde'i dpal ster rin chen dkon mchog gsum// lhag bsam dag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i char 'bebs pa// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig khyod zhabs bsten pa'i slob ma dag /log pa'i lam du nam yang mi ltung zhing*// lung dang rigs pa'i gnas la sbyor mdzad pa'i// blo bzang smra ba'i dbang por phyag 'tshal lo// tshul khrims rnam dag thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /byang chub thugs bskyed gzhan phan 'ba' zhig dgongs// rang nyid smin zhing gdul bya grol mdzad pa'i// brtse chen bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gang chos kyi de nyid legs gzigs nas// de don sems la nam yang gzhol mdzad cing*// nges don bdud rtsi'i dpal gyis 'tsho mdzad pa// chos la dbang thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gi chos tshul nod pa'i dam tshig gis// slob dpon de dag dkon mchog gsum dngos su// nges par gzigs nas dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser// mchod mdzad dam pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar gsol ba'i dge tshogs ci mchis pas// khyod kyi rjes 'jug don gnyer gdul bya'i tshogs// mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs spangs nas// brtse chen dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes 'dzin shog

/ces pa'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen kun dga' bkra shis so// ༈ //chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ chos kun mkhyen pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang bsnyes// gzhan phan la dga' bzang po'i nor gyis phyug /tshul khrims khang bzang thos pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal der gsol ba 'debs// chos 'khor kun gyi nges don 'khrul med gzigs// rgyud kun snying po dga' bzhi'i dpal gyis phyug /thugs bskyed khang bzang rgyal sras rnam thar gyi// dge mtshan dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// lung dang rigs pa'i gnas kun mthar phyin nas// 'jig rten dga' byed rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag /kun la ma rmongs phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i// ya mtshan dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// kun la byams pas snying rje'i rtsa bar mkhyen// gzhan phan la dga' thugs rje'i 'bras bur gzigs// rnam dkar mdzad pas rgyal ba dgyes mdzad pa'i// rtags mtshan mthong ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// don dam byang sems chos kun rtsa bar mkhyen// lhan skyes dga' ba rgyud sde'i snying por gzigs// thos bsam sgom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ni// tshugs par 'dzin pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// bskyed pa'i rim pas ma dag 'jug pa sel// spros bral lta bas spros pa'i tshogs kun bcad/ byang chub lam gyis bde chen tshogs gnyis po// yang dag rtogs pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// theg gsum lam ston yang dag dge ba'i bshes// bsten tshul rang rang gzhung lugs ji lta ba// legs par mkhyen te tshul bzhin goms mdzad pa// dngos grub rnyed pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs// de ltar khyod kyi legs byas phyogs tsam la// yi rang bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba des// dman pa'i sa dang bdud bzhi la 'goms nas// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang der thob shog /de skad gnas brtan rab 'byams pa// thar pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo chen gyis// sbyar 'di 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gzhung*//

༈ //brag dkar sems dpa' la bstod pa// ༄// bsod nams tshogs las grub pa'i thugs// rgyal ba'i sras por 'khrungs pa'i sku// mtshan rtog sel ba'i chos gsungs pa// khyod la gus pas gsol ba 'debs// mdo rgyud chos rnams phal cher gsan// lung dang rig pas sgro 'dogs bcad// byang chub thugs kyi ngang tshul can// khyod la gus pas gsol ba 'debs// kun la byams pas 'gro mang 'du// gzhan la brtse bas phan par dgongs// byams dang snying rje'i lam srol du// 'jug mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs// dgongs pa smon pa'i byang sems dang*// spyod pa pha rol phyin drug gis// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen po// rdzogs mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs// spyod pas bsod nams tshogs chen dang*// lta bas rgyal sras mdzad pa dang*// sgom pas dge mtshan chos rnams kun// dbang du bsdud la gsol ba 'debs// nang don rig la ma rmongs shing*// sgra tshad la sogs rig pa'i gnas// mkhyen cing gzigs pas gzhan don du// dgongs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar khyod kyi legs mdzad la// yi rang dge ba'i rnam dkar 'dis// 'gro ba ma lus byang chub kyi// thugs mchog nyid dang 'bral med shog /'di yang thar pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis// bskul nas mchog ldan gyis sbyar ba// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //gser gling pa kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ kun dga'i nyi ma bkra shis 'od stong can// lung dang rigs pa'i rta ljang gis drangs pa// rgya chen shes bya'i mkha' la shar ba na// phyogs kun mun pa bral la mgos phyag 'tshal// kun dga'i zla ba bkra shis 'od ris can// grags pa'i bde 'byung khri la 'god pa na// la la'i khengs pa lan brgyar stong mdzad pa// mang pos bsngags par 'os la mgos phyag 'tshal// mang thos khang bzang rigs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// tshul khrims mdangs gsal rigs pa'i rnga sgra can// lung rig man ngag rnam thar sgo gsum po// kun gyi 'byor pas phyug la mgos phyag 'tshal// rang gzhung rol mtsho nam yang ma 'khrugs shing*// gzhan gzhung ri gzhan mthon pos ma non par// nges don rin chen rnam bzhi'i lhun po ni// 'dzin mdzad mig stong can der mgos phyag 'tshal// ye shes snang ba nam yang mi 'dor zhing*// rnam shes snang ba 'khrul par thag bcad nas// gnyis med dbu ma'i lam la mdo sngags kyi// rnam thar sgo gsum 'byed la mgos phyag 'tshal// de ltar khyod kyi legs byas phyogs tsam dang*// dge gzhan mtha' dag yi rang gis bsdus nas// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang der bsngos pas// thub bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis byon// 'di yang thar pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis// bskul nas legs pa'i blos sbyar ba//

//shu bhaṃ// ༈ //bzhi sde mkhyen rab pa'i bstod pa// ༄// mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i gling la dbang 'byor zhing*// byang chub thugs kyi yid bzhin rin chen gyis// sa gsum 'gro ba'i phongs pa sel brtson pa// 'gro ba'i ded dpon dam par phyag 'tshal lo// nam yang mkha' ltar yangs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// gzhan phan 'od zer 'bum phrag 'gyed mdzad cing*// lung dang rtogs pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po can// dpal ldan phrin las bzang por phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lta bur kun la snyoms pa'i thugs// nyi ma'i 'od zer ji bzhin gsal ba'i gsung*// khyod sku rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod 'os pa// kun gyi bla mar gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// bod kyi lha cig btsan po'i gtsug rgyan gyi// dad pa'i chu shel stegs la gnas mdzad nas// rim gnyis ngang tshul bzang pos dus 'da' ba'i// lha'i lhar gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thos bsam sgom pa'i shing rta bzang po yis// mdo sngags bstan pa'i snying po ngo mtshar can// 'khrul med bstan pa'i lam du 'dren mdzad pa// blo chen smra ba'i dbang por phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i snying po 'dzin mkhas pa'i// grub chen gong ma'i rigs rgyud ma nyams shing*// zab lam bdud rtsi'i nying khus rgyud phyug pa// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes la rgyal ba dang*// lhag pa'i lha'i ngo bor gzigs gyur pa// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub nyer stsol ba// dpal ldan rnal 'byor bzang por mgos phyag 'tshal// mkhyen rab rgya mtsho rtag par rab bzung nas// dbang dang gdams pa'i chu bo 'bum phrag gis// skal bzang 'gro rnams smin cing grol mdzad pa// chos kyi rgya mtsho che la phyag 'tshal lo// de las byung ba'i legs tshogs ci mchis pa// phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe kun gsal nas// chos bzhin dam pa'i sgrub pa'i rgyal srid la// ma rnams sgrol ba'i mgon du bdag gyur cig

/mi dge'i grogs dang sdig pa'i grogs po dang*// 'jig rten chos dang mtshan ma'i rnam g.yeng gi /dbang du skad cig tsam yang mi 'gro bar// brtson pa drag pos chos bzhin sgrub par shog /ces zhang btsun 'od zer rgyal po'i kha bton du bya ba'i rim pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i thig le/ thub bstan dar rgyas gling du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //grub thob chu 'phur ba la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ shākya'i bstan la bsnyen par rdzogs mdzad nas// bslab gsum rin chen nam yang ma nyams shing*// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes la gsol ba 'debs// cir snang ma lus sems su mkhyen gyur cing*// sems kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol du gzigs nas// snang srid dbang du 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor pa// grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten 'di la nam yang mi sred par// gang blo chos su 'gro ba'i gdams pa yis// rang nyid smin cing 'gro mang grol mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khams gsum ma lus sdug bsngal du gzigs nas// dam chos lam du 'gro ba'i gdams pa yis// rang nyid smin cing 'gro mang grol mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ci mdzad de kun 'gro ba'i don yin pas// thar lam 'khrul pa sel ba'i gdams pa yis// rang nyid smin cing 'gro mang grol mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang shar 'dzin med chen po'i rnal rol gyis// 'khrul snang ye shes 'char ba'i gdams pa yis// rang nyid smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// yul snang sems su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// sems snang sgyu mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// sgyu 'dzin dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// dbyings rig gnyis med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// bdag bde ci yod sems can kun la bsngo// kun gyi sdug bsngal ma lus dang du len// gnyis med ngang nas gtong len thabs tshul gyis// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// grub chen nyag bre se bo yi// rnam 'phrul grub chen de nyid la// gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu rnams kyi// rgyud la byin rlabs myur 'jug cing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob bya phyir// g.yas ru gtsang gi sa phyogs kyi// thig le yid 'ong nyams dga' nas// dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blos// rab tu dwang ba'i yid kyis so//

༈ //rkong po rab 'byams pa la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ sngon tshe 'gro ba'i mgon por thugs bskyed nas// dus 'dir rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa kun// dge mtshan du ma'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur pa// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la mgos phyag 'tshal// nam yang dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes gzung mthus// rgyal bstan don la phrin las dbang po bzhin// ya mtshan rig pa'i gnas la ma rmongs pas// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// thub rnams dgyes pa'i mdzad pas dus 'da' zhing*// ma rnams sgrol ba'i don las mi g.yel bar// thub pa'i bstan la rim 'gro mdzad brtson pa// byang chub sems dpa' chen por gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin nyes pas nam yang ma gos shing*// bcas pa'i gzhung las nam yang mi 'da' bar// so so thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi// nyams len mthar phyin khyed la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// mgon med rnams kyi mgon por bdag gyur nas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan por 'dzugs pa dang*// 'dus pa'i mtsho chen rtag tu gang bar shog/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'bri khung chos rje la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ rten 'brel mthar byin 'bri khung pa de la// 'phags mchog klu sgrub dngos su byon yin zhes// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pas lung bstan pa// yid ches khungs thub gyur la gsol ba 'debs// de rjes 'jug pa'i rgyud 'dzin 'bum phrag gcig /brgya khri lhag pa 'dul 'dzin rdor gzhon las// rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs mdzad nas// grub chen ti lo paṇa chen nā ro pa'i// grub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par 'dzin nus pa// gangs can ljongs su skar ma'i grangs ji tsam// byon dang rgyun mi chad par 'byon gyur zhes// kun gyi bsngags par 'os la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas de'i ya mtshan chos kyi khri// rgyal chen rnam bzhi'i dpung pas 'dir 'degs shing*// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag pos mi bsgul ba// der byon de dag rten 'brel kun mthar phyin// kun dga'i lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin// nang gi ye shes rol mtsho ma rnyogs shing*// pha rol ri gzhan mthon pos mi snyob par// 'khor tshogs gser ri'i dbus su lham me ba// kun khyab phyag rgya che gcig thabs shes gnyis// gsum ldan bla mas nyams su bzhes de bzhin// zla 'od gzhon nu'i chos bzhis der phyug pa// lnga ldan rdo rje'i sku de zhabs brtan par// ye shes dngos grub zhabs de'i lam po che// chos drug tshang bas rdo rje 'chang thob shog

/'di ni rgya ma'i chos grub kyis// 'bri khung chos la dad thob nas// khri thogs bzhugs pa zhabs brtan pa'i// smon lam bskul ba bzhin btab pa// yin no dge shing bkra shis byon// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rgya ma kun spangs pa'i bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag pad dkar 'dzin pa'i dpal// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun bir+wa pas// rjes bzung dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin nyes pas nam yang dben pa'i sku// bcas pa'i gnas rnams ji bzhin ston pa'i gsung*// rtag tu nges par 'byung ba'i thugs mnga' bar// tshul khrims dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// rnam dag smon lam stobs kyis bskrun pa'i sku// ma rnams 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i gsung*// nges par byang chub thugs kyis rgyud phyug pa// rgyal sras chen por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// rang bzhin rnam dag rgyal ba kun gyi sku// glo bur rnam dag bde ba chen po'i gsung*// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs mnga' ba// ma lus rigs kyi bdag por gsol ba 'debs// bslab sbyangs yon tan kun gyi mthar son nas// rnam g.yeng sgyu ma'i gar la mi gzigs par// dben pa'i gnas su tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa// lung rtogs dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// 'phral dang yun gyi bgyi ba gang mdzad pa// de kun mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don nyid du// bsngo mdzad 'phrin las dbang por gsol ba 'debs// dge ba'i bshes rnams sangs rgyas dngos su mkhyen// de gsung dam chos bslu ba med par gzigs// nyams thag 'gro kun rang gi mar dgongs nas// sgrub pa'i dbang por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ma dag snang ba stong par rtogs pa dang*// nyams kyi ngang nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*// dag snang ngang gis 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyu rgyud gsal stong ngang du 'char ba dang*// thabs rgyud rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa dang*// 'bras bu bde stong lhun gyis grub gyur nas// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// snang gsum chos kyis gzhan rgyud smin pa dang*// rgyud gsum lam gyis rang rgyud grol ba dang*// rang bzhin lhan skyes lta ba rtogs pa dang*// bde stong grub mtha' snyogs par byin gyis rlobs// legs ldan lcam gyis nyer bskul nas// rje btsun dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// skal ldan shing rta'i gnas su sbyar// dge bas dam pa'i chos grub shog/

༈ //glo bo chos rje dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa bzhugs// ༄// phun tshogs chos kyi mtsho chen las 'ongs pa'i// tshul khrims rnam gsum rin chen 'bar ba'i tog /bshad bsgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor bzhugs gsol ba// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan chos rje'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rnam dpyod zhal gyis ngoms par legs gsol nas// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gces par 'dzin mdzad pa// kun gyis bkur bar 'os la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan dbang bzhis rang rgyud tshul bzhin smin// grol byed lam bzhis 'chal khrims drungs nas phyung*// 'khor lo'i mgon gyi rgyal mtshan mthon po can// khyab bdag rigs kyi bdag por gsol ba 'debs// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chu bo brgya phrag gis// khyod blo'i khor yug yangs par ngal gso nas// rnam mang 'gro ba'i rgud pa sel brtson pa// dpal ldan chos kyi rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// chos tshul mang pos nyid sku rab gang zhing*// legs bshad brgya yis khyod gsung rtag par mdzes// brtse dang byams pa'i thugs kyis rgyud bltams pas// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bstod pas bdag sogs gdul bya kun// 'chal tshul dri mas nam yang mi gos shing*// dbang dang gdams pa'i smin cing grol byas nas// dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces bya ba 'di ni sde snod 'dzin pa brtson 'grus rin chen gyis kha ton du bya ba'i rim pa nyid du bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'jam pa'i dbyangs gnyis pa kun dga' seng ge la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra bzhugs so// ༄// na maḥmañdzu shrī gho ṣa twi ā nan+ta siṃ ha yastu bhī/ rig pa'i gnas kun mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// zag med dga' bzhi 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med phrin las bzang po'i nga ro can// dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal// sngon tshe rlabs chen dge tshogs bskrun pa'i mthus// ma smad mthon po'i rigs kyi brgyud bzung nas// byams dang thugs rje'i ngang tshul bzang po can// 'gro ba'i dpal du 'khrungs la phyag 'tshal lo// tshad ldan dge ba'i bshes kyi zhabs bsten nas// thub bstan snying po sdom gsum legs mnos te// lung rigs man ngag kun la rab sbyangs pas// mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// rim gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i sbyor ba yis// dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes te// rdo rje chos skyong bran bzhin bkol mdzad pas// kun gyi bla mar gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// mang du gsan pa'i don gang rigs pa yis// legs par rtogs nas blo gsal mang po la// ring du legs par bshad pa'i phrin las kyis// bstan pa'i sgron me sbar la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon sbyangs skal bar ldan pa'i bsod nams kyis// rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyi bka' grub pas// ma lus chos kyi bdag por mnga' gsol ba// 'jam dbyangs gnyis par grags la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi mthar phyin nas// mthu stobs dpung gis bdud kyi sde bcom ste// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// grub pa'i sar bzhugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dge tshogs kyis// chos bzhin sgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsal nas// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin shog

/ces bla ma de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra zhes bya ba/ chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal pos zhal lta gnang ba'i ngor/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blos rdo rje sgrom bur sbyar ba yin no// //zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs mnga' bas// mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la lhun chags shing*// gzhan phan 'ba' zhig dgongs pa'i lhag bsam can// thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro kun dga' ba skyed pa'i phrin las dang*// rtag par chos la gzhol ba'i snying rje yis// skal bzangs gdul bya'i tshogs rnams skyong mdzad pa// sems dpa' chen po de la gsol ba 'debs// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //byams chen sku skye la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄// swasti pra dzā bh+yāḥ 'gro kun dga' ba bskyed mdzad sprul pa'i sku// dge legs bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gsung*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan bzang po// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// byang chub thugs kyi ngang tshul bzang po yis// 'gro mang gong nas gong du 'dren pa la// ma pham byams pa'i thugs rjes nges bskrun pa'i// phrin las dbang phyug mchog la gsol ba 'debs// mthong ma thag tu yid rab 'dren pa'i sku// thos pa'i mod la nye bar sim pa'i gsung*// nges par bsten na phan dang bde ster ba// thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid la gsol ba 'debs// sngon nas goms shing ring nas sbyangs pa'i mthus// sdom gsum bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' zhing*// zab dang rgya che'i chos la gdeng thob pa// bstan
