pa'i bdag por gyur la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs kyi bgyi ba gang mdzad pa// rgyal ba'i bstan dang sems can don 'ba' zhig /lhag par dgongs nas nges par brtson mdzad pa// brtse chen rgyal ba'i sras la gsol ba 'debs// mi 'gyur bde chen shin tu zab pa'i thugs// rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po mtshon pa'i sku// zung 'jug 'khor lo sgyur ba'i gsungs dbyangs kyis// tshul chen lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs// snyan rgyud gdams pa'i chu klung 'bum phrag gis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par gnas bcas nas// skal bzang skye bo'i rgud pa sel brtson pa// chos kyi rgya mtshor gus pas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dge legs kyis// khyod kyis thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs gyur pa// de kun dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// zab cing rgya che'i chos la spyod par shog

/mar gyur 'gro ba kun gyi sdig pa dang*// sdug bsngal ma lus dwang du blangs gyur nas// bde dang dge ba gzhan la bsngos byas pas// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las grol gyur cig /tshe rabs 'dir yang srid pa'i chos brgyad dang*// myang 'das zhi ba'i bde don mi gnyer bar// thub chen dbyangs pa'i lam du 'jug pa la/ phyi nang rkyen gyis gegs byed ma gyur cig /ces byams chen sku skye la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ gnyer chen rwa lo rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis sbyar ba'o// ༈ //mkhan chen legs shes pa la bstod pa/ ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dpal ldan legs par sbyangs pa'i shes rab kyis// mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol byon gyur nas// bgrang yas 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed pa// rgyal sras brtse ba can la phyag 'tshal lo// legs par gsungs pa'i mdo dang 'dul ba la// tshul bzhin 'jug pa'i shes rab rnam gsum gyis// bstan pa'i snying po ji bzhin gzigs gyur pa// mang po'i 'dren par gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// mang du gsan nas tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la// nam yang mi g.yel tshul khrims rnam pa gsum// bcas pa'i mtshams las gzhan du mi 'da' bar// bsrung mdzad dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub thugs kyi ngang tshul bzang po yis// sku gsung thugs kyi bgyi ba gang mdzad pa// mtha' yas 'gro la phan dang bde ba'i rgyur// bsngo mdzad skyes chen dam par phyag 'tshal lo// legs par bshad dang nyes par bshad pa'i cha// ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis// rigs par 'doms shing nyams su len mkhas pa// bstan pa'i dpal du shar la phyag 'tshal lo// nges par legs pa'i lam srol zla bral ba// bde stong rang rig chen po'i ye shes dang*// gang shar lha skur gzigs pa'i shes rab kyis// tshul chen lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo// legs pa'i lam gyis rang rgyud smin gyur nas// shes rab chen pos gzhan rgyud grol mdzad cing*// mkhas btsun bzang pos 'jigs med lam zhugs pa// phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis phyag btsal zhing*// gang gis legs par mdzad la yi rang bas// mar gyur mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba 'di// rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod la 'jug par shog

/ces pa 'di ni tshe dang ldan pa rab byung shes rab dpal 'byor gyis kha bton tu bya ba'i rim pa nyid du bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// ༈ //glo bo chos rje yon tan chos rgyal la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu ra we/ yon tan ri dbang gzhan las cher mtho zhing*// chos tshul rol mtsho'i dbus nas mi g.yo bar// rnam rgyal thar pa'i sgo rgya 'byed mdzad pa// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo dang sngags kyi yon tan kun 'byongs nas// byang chub thugs kyi chos tshul bzang po yis// rgyal sras chen po'i rnam thar 'dzin mkhas pa// blo ldan sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo// bslab sbyangs yon tan rdzogs pa'i lhun po la// bslab gsum chos kyi bang rim ma nyams shing*// bslab bya'i gnas rnams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin// slob mdzad bla mar gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i yon tan cir yang mi gzigs shing*// myang 'das zhi ba'i chos la'ang mi sems par// rgyal bas brnyes pa'i go 'phang de nyid la// 'gro kun 'dren mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag tu ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dpal yon gyis// thugs skyed nan tan chos la dbang 'byor nas// rgyal ba khyab bdag chen po'i rnam rol gyi// rnal 'byor g.yel ba med la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar gsol pas mtha' yas 'gro ba yi// sdig dang sdug bsngal dang du blangs gyur cing*// bde dang dge ba gzhan la bsngos byas nas// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las grol gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs spangs nas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang tshol ba la// phyi nang rkyen gyis gegs byed ma gyur cig /ces 'di yon tan blo bzang po'i// kha bton bgyid pa'i rim pa la// dad pas bskul ba'i ngor bgyis nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis sbyar//

༈ //sman 'ji ba bu chung bka' bcu pa la bstod pa// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbye ba med pa'i sku// rgyal ba'i chos kyi snying po ston pa'i gsung*// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po'i thugs mnga' ba// mang po'i 'dren par 'os la gsol ba 'debs// so thar tshul khrims bcas pa'i nyes pas dben// byang sems tshul khrims gzhan phan lhun gyis grub// sngags kyi tshul khrims smin grol rnam gnyis la// dbang 'byor dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// lung rigs gzhung la sbyangs pa mi dman zhing*// mtha' yas rgyud sde'i snying po legs rtogs nas// man ngag tshul bzhin sgom la mnga' brnyes pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rigs par bsten mkhas shing*// sdom gsum mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung la brtson// gzhan phan 'ba' zhig dgongs pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rgyal sras sems dpa' che la gsol ba 'debs// nam yang gzhan la mtho 'tshams mi mnga' zhing*// rang nyid 'jig rten chos la mi 'jug par// srid zhi mnyam nyid ngang nas dam pa'i chos// tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad de la gsol ba 'debs// gang yang chos bzhin sgrub pa'i dam pa la// lha dang bla mas rtag tu nyer dgongs shing*// dam can rnams kyi rtag tu bsrung mdzad pas// bdud dang bar chad sel la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis gsol btab nas// phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis kyis// srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus sel byed shog /ces pa 'di ni gsol ja ba rdo rje rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gser mdog can du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gling smad chos rje la bstod pa// ༄// swasti/ rgya chen chos kyi mig stong rab yangs shing*// zab mo'i don rnams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin// 'khrul med gzigs pa'i dge mtshan bgrang yas kyi// dpal ldan phrin las bzang por phyag 'tshal lo// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i shes rab dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal rigs pa'i nga ro yis// mtshan 'dzin chos su smra rnams 'joms mdzad pa// 'jigs med smra ba'i dbang por phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i chos la thos bsam mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba dges mdzad bsgrub pa'i mchod pa dang*// dge mtshan du ma'i dpal gyis mngon mtho ba// phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lung rigs mkhas mang 'tshogs pa'i dbus dag tu// 'jigs med chos kyi nga ro cher bsgrags pas// dri med grags pa'i gdugs dkar g.yo bzhin du// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la mgos phyag 'tshal// rang bzhin tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri mas dben// rnam dag tshul khrims bcas pa'i rwa ba las// nam yang mi 'da' thub pa'i ring lugs pa// kun gyi rgyal mtshan tshugs par 'dzin la 'dud// thos bsam sgom pa'i chos kyis rgyud sbyangs shing*// 'chad rtsod brtsom pas gzhan rgyud grol mdzad nas// rgyal ba'i sras kyi thugs bskyed rgya mtshor ni// nyin mtshan g.yel ba med la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nam yang dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*// thub pa'i bstan pa ring du gnas pa dang*// tshogs mchog 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho 'phel bar shog/

//shu bhaṃ// //swasti/ lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis brlabs gyur pas// sku btsun gsung mkhas thugs kyi chu gter ni// bzang po'i grags pas mngon par byang chub pa// chos kyi dbang phyug nyid la gsol ba 'debs// grub pa mchog dang pha rol phyin pa yi// rnal 'byor lam la g.yel ba med bzhin du// don gnyer slob ma'i sems rgyud tshim mdzad pa// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// nges don ji bzhin gzigs pa'i shes rab ni// tshul khrims dri bsung 'phro ba'i gos bzang can// ting 'dzin lam gyis nges par rgyud phyug pa// bslab gsum ma nyams gong mar bcas la 'dud// tha snyad gzhung brgya'i tshul la ma rmongs shing*// mdo dang rgyud sde'i don dam zab mo la// som nyid spangs pa'i dga' dang bde ba yis// rtag par tshim mdzad khyed la gsol ba 'debs// dge ba 'di yis mar gyur 'gro ba kun// mi dge'i lam du nam yang mi 'jug cing*// rtag par dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan gyis// bskul nas legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// //dge'o// ༈ //gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gsol 'debs// ༄// gzhon nu rab byung thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /tshul khrims rnam dag sdom gsum gces 'dzin pa// gzhi dus spyod pa rnam dag yin no zhes// ston mdzad dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs// gdod nas grub pa'i rang rig rang gsal ba// glo bur dri mas 'grib par mi nus kyang*// gnyis snang 'khrul pa rang ngo ma shes par// ston mdzad chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// glo bur dri ma'i ngo bo phyag rgya cher// 'phral dang gdod nas grub pa yod min zhes// sems snang sgyu ma lam gyi lta bar ni// ston mdzad chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// kun rdzob chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong par shes nas 'od gsal 'ba' zhig la// lam du nyams len kun gyi gzhi yin zhes// ston mdzad longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs// 'bras bu'i dus kyi yon tan ji snyed pa// gzhi'i dus nas lhun gyis grub po zhes// glo bur sprin gyis nam mkha' mi 'grib par// ston mdzad chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// rnam shes yul du gang snang de nyid dang*// ye shes yul du gang snang de las gzhan// yod ma yin pa 'bras dus lta bar ni// ston mdzad ngo bo nyid skur gsol ba 'debs// gzhi lam 'bras gsum gang du grub pa'i gzhi// dbyer med rtogs nas gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i blo// ji srid 'char bar gyur pa de srid du// blang dor tshul bzhin byed par byin gyis brlobs// de skad 'di ni ku rab pa'i// chos mdzad rtogs ldan dge slong gi

/gsung gi ngor byas gzhi dus kyi// phyag rgya chen por mos blos sbyar// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //blo gsal rnams kyis mchod yar du bya ba'i rim pa// ༄// na maḥswa ra swasti/ rab dkar gangs ri gsar pa'i mdangs 'phrog ma// rab snyan dri za'i dbyangs la co 'dri ma// rab gsal snyan ngag phreng ba spel brtson ma// ma ltar brtse ba'i lha mo dbyangs can ma// margad 'khyil pa'i mtsho 'gram der bzhugs ma// ngang mo'i lus can ji bzhin rang gi ngang*// na chung gzugs kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' na// lo ma'i gur du byon la phyag 'tshal lo// ngo mtshar tshogs gnyis gser gyi sa gzhis bteg pa'i sku gsum lhun po'i spo la brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo mang phye ba'i rnam rgyal gser gyi khang bzangs yid 'ong stobs bcu'i go 'phang mthon pos rab brjid gzungs dang mngon par shes pa'i rin chen drwa mig cher gsal byams dang snying rje'i rnga yab 'khrug ldan phrin las phyogs brgyar gsal ba'i rnga yab dkar po dang ldan srid pa ngal bso'i bsti gnas mchog gyur mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la brjid chags yang dag rigs pa'i rtse brgya khros pas bdud dang lha min pham mdzad bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de dang de'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa sgo gsum gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod// yab rje rgyal ba nyid kyi shel gyi cod paṇa dkar po nyid kyi dbu la legs blangs dga' ldan chos kyi khri la kun dgar rol mdzad sna tshogs mdo sde'i rgyan bzang ngo mtshar bkra shis gser gyi yu ba la brten mngon rtogs yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyan phreng mtshar du mngar ba'i gdugs dkar thig le'i bsil yab legs 'bab theg chen rgyud bla'i yid bzhin tog gis gang la ci dga'i dgos 'dod nyer stsol 'byed gnyis g.yer kha'i gsung snyan gyis ni shes ldan mgron po dbang du bsdud pas thub bstan gser gyi khang chen kun gyi yid khar 'ong mdzad rje btsun mi pham thugs rje'i dbang phyug de nyid sgo gsum gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod// rnam dpyod tsan+dan ljon pa'i ngos la bstar ba'i rigs pa'i thang chu dkar pos 'gram pa rab mdzes dngos 'dzin grub mtha'i mche ba dkar po gnam du rab sgreng log blos skyod pa'i snying stobs ring nas khros te 'ongs pa'i glang chen smyon pa'i klad pa rnam par 'gems byed dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge 'jigs med bzang po'i zhabs pad gang de mchod// mkhyen pa'i snang bas nyi ma pham byed// brtse ba'i zer gyis zla ba 'god mdzad// nus pa'i stobs kyis lha min dregs nyams// 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyis dri za'i mdang 'phrog

/rtsod pa rdo rjes stobs dgra skyengs byed// rtsom pa'i rnga sgras dbyangs can dges mdzad// snyan grags shes bya'i pha mtha' dang 'grogs// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dpal rab skyong mkhas// ma pham thugs rje'i sprul pa mngon gyur// lhag pa'i lha yis mngon sum zhal bstan// rdo rje chos skyong bran bzhin 'khol mdzad// mi pham g.yag gi mtshan can de nyid mchod// shākya'i bstan pa 'chi med nor bu'i dpal 'bar legs bshad pad+ma rā ga'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod snyan grags gser gyi ut+pal phreng ba zhabs sen zla ba'i thig phreng gang dang lhan cig 'jig rten cher rlom yongs kyi ral pas len byed 'gyur khugs stong gis mtshar du mngar ba'i gnas lnga rigs pa'i rnga dbyangs rten 'byung zab mo'i rgyud mangs la bsgyur srid gsum sgyu mar shar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol rgya gar paṇa chen yongs kyi dregs 'joms gangs can mkhas pa rnams kyi the tshom sel ba'i dbang po thub dbang gnyis pa rong ston shes bya kun rig de nyid mchod// mang du gsan pas gzhung lugs kun gyi de nyid gsal bar legs gzigs de don rtag par bsgrub pa lhur mdzad yod dang med smra'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma'i nags kyi sman ljongs nyams dgar gsung rab ma lus mkhyen pa'i nyams kyis rnam rol dpal ldan rigs pa 'dzin pa'i sa chen bzang po la bzhugs phrin las dbang po don yod dpal zhes snyan grags gser gyi rna cha kun gyi rna bar 'phyang byed de nyid mchod// rnam dpyod 'bigs byed dri gzhon shugs kyis ches cher drangs pa'i rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i legs bshad gsar pa'i ha ri tsan+dan ljon pa'i phrin las dri zhim blo gsal kun gyi yid 'phrog bgyid pa'i nags kyi nang na mang du thos pa'i rna ba dang ni lung dang rigs pa'i mig gnyis rab yangs sgra dang tshad ma'i mche sder rnon pos gzhung mang log par 'chad pa'i chang gis myos shing dregs pa'i glang chen smyon pa'i khyu chen khyad du gsod byed bslab gsum goms stabs brtan par 'god mdzad phyi nang sde snod lus stobs grims shing mdzangs pas blo gsal ri dwags skyong mkhas dpal ldan 'jigs med smra ba'i dbang po shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros sgo gsum gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod// dkon mchog nor bu 'bar ba'i rin chen tog mdzes bslab gsum rgyal mtshan mthon po bzung nas blo gros 'o ma'i chu gter yangs par sde snod gsum gyi 'dab brgya rgyas pa'i dga' ba'i tshal du shes ldan mgron po'i tshogs rnams rnam dag lung gis mgu byed yang dag rigs pa'i pang+mo'i phreng ba blo gsal mang po'i mgul ba'i rgyan du nyer mtshon sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gsal byed yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid de ltar mchod// ces pa 'di ni lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i mchog sgra dang snyan ngag gi rgya mtshor gyur pa dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis chums su sbyar ba'o//
